title: Atomic return and manifest finalization
description: Publish canonical durable returns and manifests atomically and consume a sidecar identity receipt.

clauses.text: Build mutable return or manifest content without a self-referential raw-byte digest. Use the deterministic finalizer to canonicalize, fill generated fields, validate schema, resolve referenced identities, and publish the immutable object atomically.
Consume the finalizer sidecar identity receipt for byte count and SHA-256. Do not manually edit a finalized object to repair its own identity fields.
A carrier-only correction invalidates only the carrier receipt and directly dependent package closure. Preserve unchanged candidate, test, assertion, and product evidence.
